sample_unit: prompts (drug orders requiring renal dose adjustment)

links.outcome: AI accuracy in renal dose adjustment assessment versus UpToDate
links.effect: DeepThink had 81.6% sensitivity, 29% specificity, 67.5% accuracy; ChatGPT 5.0 had 64.3% sensitivity, 54.8% specificity, 61.7% accuracy.
links.quote: DeepThink® showed the highest sensitivity (81.6 %) but low specificity (29 %) and 67.5 % accuracy.

links.outcome: AI clinical knowledge on renal dosing compared with current guideline (UpToDate)
links.effect: Accuracy 61.7% for ChatGPT 5.0 and 67.5% for DeepThink against UpToDate; modest improvement across ChatGPT versions.
links.quote: With advances in the ChatGPT® model, there was a modest improvement in prediction capacity, with the latest ChatGPT® 5.0 achieving balanced performance (64.3 % sensitivity, 54.8 % specificity, 61.7 % accuracy).

screen.reason: The study tests several LLMs (ChatGPT and DeepSeek models) on prompts derived from real patient clinical cases to assess their accuracy in renal dose adjustment, but does not test any deployment practice or safeguard.
